_comments: Issue #77, c77.4: Orders creates a subscription when its order is booked, usually after the order
was linked to the contract, so the copy at link time finds nothing. This re-applies every linked
contract's terms. Idempotent: a subscription already carrying the terms is not saved.

fields.Name: Sweep Contract Renewal Terms
fields.Description: Copy every linked contract's annual increase (when stated) and carry-discount flag to the subscriptions its orders created. Subscriptions already carrying the terms are left alone.
fields.UserPrompt: Copy contract renewal terms to the subscriptions of their linked orders.
